'''2013 SoCal Grand Prix Day 1 Steve Harpster DS Ralltiir Operations''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Steve Harpster]] at [[2013 SoCal Grand Prix]] (Day 1).


== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' [[Ralltiir Operations / In The Hands Of The Empire]]
* '''Format:''' [[Legacy Open]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 1
